summary: Phase 1 i18n foundation frontend verification. Landing (/login), SignIn (patient/internal/partner), Activate (invalid state), patient portal shell (nav + PortalHome tiles), auth end-to-end (patient -> /portal, staff -> /internal), and mobile 390px landing were all tested. Found and fixed one critical bug: PortalHome tiles were displaying raw i18n keys (tiles.appointments, tiles.prescriptions, etc.) because tkey values were missing the 'home.' prefix required by the JSON structure at portal.home.tiles.*. After fix, all 8 tiles render correct English text. No raw i18n keys remain on any converted screen. ES/FR selector items are properly disabled (aria-disabled=true, title='Coming soon'). Auth flows unchanged and functional.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - tkey used bare 'tiles.<name>' but JSON path is portal.home.tiles.<name>, resulting in raw keys 'tiles.appointments' etc. displayed on the portal home screen. Prefixed all TILES tkeys with 'home.'. Verified after fix: all 8 tiles render English labels correctly.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider adding a lightweight dev-time sanity check (e.g. i18next missingKeyHandler console.warn) to catch similar tkey/JSON path mismatches during Phase 2 language conversions.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalHome.jsx used useTranslation(['portal']) with tkey 'tiles.x' but portal.json nests tiles under home.tiles.x. Same pattern in PortalLayout NAV correctly uses namespaced 'portal:nav.home'. Recommend consistency: either always namespaced ('portal:home.tiles.x') or always relative to defaultNS - mixed style is bug-prone.
SignIn.jsx 'Back' button (line 57) still hardcoded 'Back' rather than t('common:actions.back'). Minor inconsistency for Phase 1 scope but noted.

i18n.js uses LanguageDetector with localStorage caching + lookupLocalStorage='visita_lang'; combined with lng:'en' this forces English on first load but a stale visita_lang='es'/'fr' entry in localStorage from a future test could override. Consider ignoring detector until Phase 2 or restricting to supportedLngs=ENABLED_LANGUAGES.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (1 critical bug found and fixed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 i18n complete and verified. Converted files: Landing, SignIn, Activate, PortalLayout (nav), PortalHome (tiles). Still hardcoded English (Phase 2 pending, not bugs): Register, Re-establish Care, PortalAccount, PortalAppointments, Bloodwork, Imaging, Prescriptions, Referrals, Messages, MyRequests. When Phase 2 lands, watch for the same class of bug (tkey path vs JSON path mismatch) - PortalHome had it.
rca of the issue: PortalHome.jsx defined TILES entries with tkey values like 'tiles.appointments'. useTranslation(['portal']) sets 'portal' as the default namespace, so t('tiles.appointments') resolved to portal.tiles.appointments which does NOT exist in en/portal.json - the tiles are nested under 'home': portal.home.tiles.appointments. i18next with returnEmptyString:false and no missingKeyHandler simply returned the key string, which then rendered on the UI as 'tiles.appointments' etc. Fix: prefixed each tkey with 'home.' -> 'home.tiles.appointments'. Verified by re-logging in as Maria Lopez and confirming all 8 tiles show correct English labels.
